
== Foil appearance review, 13 November 2026 ==
Bill observed that this photograph does not visibly show a foil finish. Inspection confirms that the image does not show clear diffraction or reflected foil highlights comparable to [[:File:Promo-Foil-L-afewmaneuvers.jpg|A Few Maneuvers]] and [[:File:Promo-Foil-L-corelliancorvette.jpg|Corellian Corvette]]. It has therefore been removed from the [[Premiere]] article's promotional-foil gallery in favor of those two clearer examples.

This visual observation does not establish that the photographed card is a non-foil. The [[:File:Promo-Foil-L-rebelbarrier.jpg|File description]] identifies a seller image, and [[Rebel Barrier (Promotional Foil)]] remains a documented release. A replacement photograph should show the actual foil finish before this image is used as a visual foil example again. The stored image has not been altered or deleted.
